card.text: Explore Lydia in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 152 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with the thermally preferred pole and a published 90–92 km diameter fit range. The archive mesh uses 91 km; another pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 152 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 45.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
